kvcoder.title: Coder
kvcoder.app.title: kvman Coder
kvcoder.errors.QUESTION_NOT_FOUND: This question was already answered, dismissed, or cancelled.
kvcoder.errors.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: This chat doesn't exist in this workspace.
kvcoder.errors.SESSION_BUSY: The chat is working; try again when its step ends.
kvcoder.errors.JOB_NOT_FOUND: This chat started no such background job.

kvcoder.errors.MCP_SIGN_IN_NEEDED: The MCP server {server} needs you to sign in.

kvcoder.notices.SUMMARY_FAILED: The earlier messages couldn't be summarized: {error}

kvcoder.notices.REPLY_INCOMPLETE: The model's reply was empty or cut off at its length limit, twice in a row. Retry, or choose another model.
kvcoder.ui.staging.changed: This run changed what is staged in Git ({paths} paths).
kvcoder.ui.staging.headMoved: This run moved HEAD, so staging can't be restored here.
kvcoder.ui.costEstimate: Cost is an estimate from the model catalog
kvcoder.ui.memoryDetail: The model now holds {tokens} of its {window} tokens. Older messages are summarized at {at}%.
kvcoder.ui.sendFailed: Couldn't send: {error} Your message is still here; send it again to retry.
kvcoder.ui.answerFailed: Couldn't confirm your answer: {error}. Your draft is saved; try again.
kvcoder.ui.queued: Sent · read after the current step
kvcoder.ui.working.fork: Copying the chat into a new one…
kvcoder.ui.nothingToSummarize: Nothing to summarize yet: the messages before the last {count} are still short
kvcoder.ui.pasteFailed: The clipboard couldn't be read. Use the attach button.
kvcoder.ui.enterSends: Enter sends · Shift+Enter for a new line
kvcoder.ui.stopFailed: Couldn't stop: {error} Press Stop to try again.
kvcoder.ui.stopEnds: Stop ends the turn; its helpers stop too.
kvcoder.ui.startPlaceholder: Describe a change, a bug, or an idea…
kvcoder.ui.approvalNote.loading: Checking when commands ask for approval…
kvcoder.ui.approvalNote.failed: Couldn't load when commands ask for approval.
kvcoder.ui.approvalNote.ask: Ask mode requests approval before shell or binary execution, file writes or edits, and MCP tool calls. Registered commands marked as needing approval also ask; reads and help do not all require approval.
kvcoder.ui.approvalNote.auto: Auto mode is the default, but this is your loaded effective mode. For shell or binary execution, file writes or edits, and MCP tool calls, the model supplies the risky flag: risky:false may run without approval; other values ask. Registered commands marked as needing approval still ask.
kvcoder.ui.approvalNote.never: Never-ask mode requests no approval. Shell or binary execution, file writes or edits, MCP tool calls, registered commands marked as needing approval, and worker programs set to ask all run at once. The agent's own questions to you still wait for your answer.
kvcoder.ui.approvalNote.limits: Approval is not sandboxing: a run program can change what it can reach, and what you send can reach the model and its providers.
kvcoder.ui.approvalLine.auto: The agent asks you before risky actions.
kvcoder.ui.approvalLine.ask: The agent asks you before every action that changes something.
kvcoder.ui.approvalLine.never: The agent acts without asking you.
kvcoder.ui.chatNotHere: This chat isn't in this workspace.
kvcoder.ui.messageDismisses: Sending a message skips the questions and denies the commands.
kvcoder.ui.promptTitle: The exact system prompt the next step sends
kvcoder.ui.deleteConfirm: Delete this chat and its helpers' chats?
kvcoder.session.create.description: Creates a session in this workspace.
kvcoder.session.list.description: Lists this workspace's top-level sessions, newest first.
kvcoder.session.count.description: Counts this workspace's top-level sessions, of one status or all.
kvcoder.session.rename.description: Renames a session; kvcoder never retitles it after that.
kvcoder.session.configure.description: Changes a session's model or thinking level, from its next step.
kvcoder.session.delete.description: Deletes a session: cancels its turn and deletes its subagent sessions.
kvcoder.session.compact.description: Summarizes a session's older messages now; the last 10 stay whole. Says whether a summary was made.
kvcoder.session.fork.description: Copies a session's messages, and its summary, through a seq into a new session.
kvcoder.session.export.description: Writes a session, its turns and messages, and its subagent sessions to a JSON file.
kvcoder.session.title.description: Writes a session's title from its first turn.
kvcoder.session.prune.description: Deletes the oldest idle top-level sessions beyond kvcoder.sessions.keep.
kvcoder.message.send.description: Sends the person's message: it starts a turn, steers the running one, or answers a waiting one. A repeat with the same sendId is acknowledged and adds nothing.
kvcoder.message.inject.description: Adds an extension's message to a session, as the person's message would be, marked as the extension's.
kvcoder.context.get.description: Gives the size of a session's prompt in tokens, its model's context window, and the share at which older messages are summarized.
kvcoder.message.list.description: Lists a session's newest messages in order, the count of older ones, and the messages waiting for the step; with beforeSeq, the newest of those before it.
kvcoder.note.add.description: Adds a display-only note to a session; it never reaches the model and never starts a turn.
kvcoder.turn.retry.description: Runs a stopped turn again on the session's history, without adding a message.
kvcoder.turn.cancel.description: Cancels a session's turn: its step, its subagents' turns, and its questions. With turnId, only when that turn is still the current one.
kvcoder.turn.list.description: Lists a session's turns, newest first.
kvcoder.turn.step.description: Runs one step of a session's turn.
kvcoder.question.answer.description: Answers a pending question or approval; returns the next step's job id once nothing else is pending.
kvcoder.shell.run.description: Runs one line in the real shell, in the workspace folder.
kvcoder.binary.run.description: Runs the program with the given arguments in the real shell, in the workspace folder.
kvcoder.fs.file.get.description: Reads lines of a text file.
kvcoder.fs.entry.list.description: Lists the files and folders of one folder.
kvcoder.fs.path.list.description: Finds the files whose path matches a glob, under a folder, newest first.
kvcoder.fs.text.search.description: Finds the lines that match a regular expression, in a file or under a folder.
kvcoder.fs.write.description: Creates a file and its parent folders, or replaces the file.
kvcoder.fs.edit.description: Replaces exact pieces of text in an existing file; if one replacement fails, nothing is written.
kvcoder.fs.undo.description: Takes back this chat's latest change to a file, when the file hasn't changed since.
kvcoder.fs.part.description: Saves one numbered piece of a long file, without writing the file yet.
kvcoder.fs.assemble.description: Writes a file from its saved parts, in order, and drops them; names the missing numbers when one is absent.
kvcoder.artifact.write.description: Creates an artifact, or replaces its title, format, and content.
kvcoder.artifact.edit.description: Replaces exact pieces of text in an existing artifact; if one replacement fails, nothing changes.
kvcoder.artifact.content.get.description: Reads an artifact with its content.
kvcoder.map.set.description: Makes the execution map's skeleton, or replaces it; a step whose id stays keeps its details and how far it got.
kvcoder.map.step.details.set.description: Writes the details of one step of the map.
kvcoder.map.step.update.description: Changes the status of one or more steps of the map.
kvcoder.map.note.add.description: Adds a finding to the map's "Noted for later" list.
kvcoder.map.state.get.description: Reads the execution map without the steps' details, or one step whole.
kvcoder.background.list.description: Lists this chat's newest 50 background runs, newest first, each with its id, kind, title, and status.
kvcoder.background.output.get.descriptio: Gives one background run's status, and its output (a process's last lines, a subagent's answer, or what a program worker's run returned).
kvcoder.background.wait.description: Waits until a background run ends or the time passes, then gives its status and output as output does.
kvcoder.background.stop.description: Stops a background process or a program worker's run, or cancels a background subagent.
kvcoder.mcp.tool.describe.description: Lists an MCP server's tools, or gives one tool's description and arguments.
kvcoder.mcp.tool.call.description: Calls one tool of an MCP server and returns the tool's text.
kvcoder.mcp.steps.run.description: Calls several tools of an MCP server on one connection, in order, so the server keeps its state between them; stops at the first tool that reports an error.
kvcoder.mcp.server.check.description: Connects to one MCP server and says whether it is ready, needs a sign-in, or failed.
kvcoder.mcp.sign-in.start.description: Starts your sign-in to an MCP server and gives the address to open.
kvcoder.mcp.sign-in.finish.description: Finishes a sign-in with the code the server sent back.
kvcoder.ask.text.check.description: Asks the person for a free answer and waits for it.
kvcoder.ask.choice.check.description: Asks the person to choose among options and waits for the answer.
kvcoder.ask.confirm.check.description: Asks the person yes or no and waits for the answer.
kvcoder.delegate.check.description: Runs a worker on a task; several runs in one reply run in parallel.
kvcoder.delegate.continue.check.descript: Sends a follow-up to a helper of this chat that has ended, such as one that came back blocked or with questions: it continues with its own history.
kvcoder.delegate.worker.check.descriptio: Checks that a worker's program is installed; a subagent is always ready.
kvcoder.delegate.worker.run.description: Runs a program worker's program on its task, and gives the chat its answer.
kvcoder.connector.help.get.description: Gives a connector's help: its commands, or one command's payload, result, and examples.
kvcoder.connector.register.description: Registers a connector the agent calls with its run tool: the caller's public commands, or a program run in the shell.
kvcoder.connector.unregister.description: Removes one of the caller's connectors.
kvcoder.connector.list.description: Lists the connectors the agent may use.
kvcoder.connector.enable.description: Switches the caller's own optIn connectors on for one chat.
kvcoder.slash.register.description: Registers slash commands of the send box, each running one of the caller's public commands.
kvcoder.slash.unregister.description: Removes one of the caller's slash commands.
kvcoder.slash.list.description: Lists the slash commands that extensions added to the send box.
kvcoder.section.set.description: Sets one of the caller's sections of the system prompt.
kvcoder.section.remove.description: Removes one of the caller's sections; a missing one does nothing.
kvcoder.section.list.description: Lists the sections a session's prompt reaches, or the workspace's without a session.
kvcoder.handler.register.description: Registers one of the caller's public commands to be queued at a session point.
kvcoder.handler.unregister.description: Removes the caller's handler of a session point; each extension has its own.
kvcoder.handler.run.description: Runs a session handler's command, remembering its job so the handler's injections start no turn.
kvcoder.prompt.get.description: Gives the exact system prompt of a session's next step, and its sections.
kvcoder.ui.get.description: Gives kvcoder's pages, nav item, and status item.
kvcoder.docs.list.description: Lists the documentation pages of kvcoder.
kvcoder.docs.get.description: Gives one documentation page of kvcoder.
kvcoder.model.title: Model
kvcoder.model.description: The model a new chat starts with.
kvcoder.delegate.model.title: Model for workers
kvcoder.delegate.model.description: The model a helper uses when its worker names none.
kvcoder.thinking.title: Thinking
kvcoder.thinking.description: How hard the model thinks in a new chat.
kvcoder.maxSteps.title: Steps per turn
kvcoder.maxSteps.description: The most steps a turn takes before it stops. Leave it empty for no limit.
kvcoder.approval.title: Approval
kvcoder.approval.description: When the agent asks you before it runs a command, changes a file, or does anything else that needs your go-ahead.
kvcoder.config.approval.never.title: Never ask before a call?
kvcoder.config.approval.never.text: The agent will run commands, change files, change kvman itself, and start worker programs without asking you. What it reads can steer it.
kvcoder.shell.path.title: Shell program
kvcoder.shell.path.description: The shell program that runs commands. Leave it empty to find bash, or PowerShell on Windows.
kvcoder.compactAt.title: Summarize at
kvcoder.compactAt.description: How full the model's context may get before older messages are summarized: 0.8 is 80%.
kvcoder.compactKeep.title: Messages kept whole
kvcoder.compactKeep.description: How many of the newest messages stay as they are when older ones are summarized, from 1 to 100.
kvcoder.connectors.title: Binary connectors
kvcoder.connectors.description: Programs the agent may run as connectors, written as a JSON list.
kvcoder.sessions.keep.title: Chats to keep
kvcoder.sessions.keep.description: How many chats to keep in each workspace. 0 keeps them all.
kvcoder.profile.title: Agent profile
kvcoder.profile.description: A product's agent: who it is, how it works, and the Chat page's words. Only the app's preset sets it.
kvcoder.job.list.description: A chat's newest 50 background jobs (processes, subagents, and program workers' runs), running ones first.
kvcoder.job.get.description: One background job of a chat with its output: a process's last 100 lines, a subagent's result, or what a program worker's run returned.
kvcoder.job.cancel.description: Stops a running background process or program worker's run of a chat, or cancels its background subagent.
kvcoder.delegate.staging.restore.descrip: Puts back what was staged in Git before a program worker's run; it changes no file and no commit.
kvcoder.artifact.list.description: Lists the artifacts of a chat, newest change first.
kvcoder.artifact.get.description: Gives one artifact of a chat with its content.
kvcoder.map.get.description: Gives a chat's execution map, or null when it has none.
kvcoder.ui.backgroundDecision: A background helper needs your decision.
kvcoder.ui.jobs.title: Background jobs
kvcoder.ui.activity.retryingRateLimited: Retrying in {seconds} s: the provider is limiting calls ({attempt} of {of})
kvcoder.ui.activity.retryingUnavailable: Retrying in {seconds} s: the provider didn't answer ({attempt} of {of})
kvcoder.ui.artifacts.title: Artifacts
kvcoder.ui.map.title: Execution map
kvcoder.ui.map.remaining: {count} steps of the execution map are not done.
kvcoder.ui.artifacts.urlRefused: This address can't be shown here: only pages on localhost or 127.0.0.1, and never kvman itself, are.
kvcoder.connectors.disabled.title: Connectors turned off
kvcoder.connectors.disabled.description: The connectors the agent can't use, by name.
kvcoder.mcp.servers.title: MCP servers
kvcoder.mcp.servers.description: The MCP servers the agent can use through the mcp connector.
kvcoder.delegate.workers.title: Workers
kvcoder.delegate.workers.description: The workers the agent can hand a task to through the delegate connector.
kvcoder.config.connectors.intro: A connector is something the agent can use. Turn one off and the agent no longer sees it, from its next step.
kvcoder.config.connector.shell: Runs command lines in the workspace folder.
kvcoder.config.connector.fs: Reads, writes, edits, lists, and searches files.
kvcoder.config.connector.artifact: Writes the documents and pages shown beside the chat.
kvcoder.config.connector.execution-map: Plans the work as steps you watch on a diagram, and tracks what is done.
kvcoder.config.connector.background: Lists, reads, and stops what runs in the background.
kvcoder.config.connector.ask: Asks you a question and waits for your answer.
kvcoder.config.connector.delegate: Hands part of a task to a worker: another agent with its own instructions.
kvcoder.config.connector.mcp: Uses the tools of the MCP servers you add.
kvcoder.config.setting.reset.workspace: Use the value for all workspaces
kvcoder.config.setting.ownValue: {name} has its own value. Switch to {name} to change it.
kvcoder.config.mcp.intro: MCP servers give the agent more tools. Each one is checked when you open this list.
kvcoder.config.mcp.empty: No servers yet. Add one and the agent can use its tools.
kvcoder.config.mcp.signIn.blocked: Your browser blocked the sign-in tab. Allow pop-ups for kvman, then press Sign in again.
kvcoder.config.mcp.signIn.unfinished: The server sent no code: the sign-in was cancelled or refused.
kvcoder.config.mcp.signIn.retry: Close this tab and press Sign in again.
kvcoder.config.mcp.form.name: Name
kvcoder.config.mcp.form.nameHint: What the agent calls it: lowercase letters, digits, and dashes, such as github.
kvcoder.config.mcp.form.descriptionHint: What the server is for. The agent reads this to decide when to use it.
kvcoder.config.mcp.form.commandHint: The program to start, such as npx or uvx.
kvcoder.config.mcp.form.secretsHint: Values are kept as secrets and are never shown again.
kvcoder.config.mcp.form.moved: This server now points somewhere else: type its values again, and sign in again if it needs a sign-in.
kvcoder.config.mcp.invalid.nameShape: Use lowercase letters, digits, and dashes, starting with a letter.
kvcoder.config.mcp.invalid.descriptionEm: Say what the server is for.
kvcoder.config.mcp.invalid.commandEmpty: Give the command that starts the server.
kvcoder.config.mcp.invalid.url: Give an address that starts with http:// or https://.
kvcoder.config.mcp.invalid.valueName.env: A variable's name has letters, digits, and _, and doesn't start with a digit.
kvcoder.config.mcp.invalid.valueName.hea: A header's name has no spaces and no colon.
kvcoder.config.mcp.invalid.valueRepeated: Each name can be given once.
kvcoder.config.mcp.invalid.valueEmpty: Give each new name a value, or remove its row.
kvcoder.config.workers.intro: A worker is another agent the main agent can hand part of a task to. Turn one off and the agent no longer sees it.
kvcoder.config.workers.empty: No workers yet. Add one and the agent can hand it a task.
kvcoder.config.workers.form.name: Name
kvcoder.config.workers.form.nameHint: What the agent calls it: lowercase letters, digits, and dashes, such as reviewer.
kvcoder.config.workers.form.descriptionH: What the worker is for. The agent reads this to decide when to use it.
kvcoder.config.workers.form.instructions: The worker's role and rules, added to its system prompt. Leave empty for a general helper.
kvcoder.config.workers.form.readOnlyHint: It can read, search, ask, and write its report. Anything that could change something is refused.
kvcoder.config.workers.form.connectorsHi: What the worker can use. It can always ask you a question, and never hands work on.
kvcoder.config.workers.invalid.nameShape: Use lowercase letters, digits, and dashes, starting with a letter.
kvcoder.config.workers.invalid.descripti: Say what the worker is for.
kvcoder.config.workers.invalid.instructi: The instructions are longer than 16 KB.
kvcoder.config.workers.invalid.connector: Tick at least one connector, or choose All.
kvcoder.config.workers.form.kindHint: A subagent runs inside kvman. The others run a program installed on this computer, which signs in by its own means.
kvcoder.config.workers.form.approvalHint: The program edits files and runs commands on its own, without asking you again.
kvcoder.config.workers.form.minutesHint: From 1 to 120. A run that takes longer is stopped.
kvcoder.config.workers.form.programDefau: Leave empty for the program's own default.
kvcoder.config.workers.form.autoApprove: Let it approve its own actions (--auto)
kvcoder.config.workers.form.toolsHint: One per line. Leave empty for the program's own tools.
kvcoder.config.workers.form.permissionMo: How the program decides about its own edits and commands.
kvcoder.config.workers.invalid.minutes: Give a whole number of minutes from 1 to 120.
kvcoder.config.workers.invalid.unattende: A worker that starts at once can't also approve its own actions. Choose "Ask me", or a stricter setting below.
kvcoder.config.connectors.reset.workspac: Use the list for all workspaces
kvcoder.config.connectors.ownValue: {name} has its own list. Switch to {name} to change it.
kvcoder.config.model.reset.workspace: Use the value for all workspaces
kvcoder.config.model.ownValue: {name} has its own value. Switch to {name} to change it.
kvcoder.ui.slash.title: Commands
kvcoder.ui.slash.fork: Copy this chat into a new one
kvcoder.ui.slash.prompt: Show the prompt, or go back to the chat
kvcoder.ui.slash.wait: Send a first message to use commands
kvcoder.ui.failure.invalid: The agent's request wasn't valid, so nothing ran.
